fusions.name: Between the Lames
fusions.desc: A thrust between the plates of an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Two Deep in File
fusions.desc: Thrusts along a narrow line 4 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Front Rank Steady
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pike-Studded Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures a spiked harness: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
